## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      8 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 15.07.2026 - 14.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Db_, 08.09.2026, 1/5: "This is a open source app and opensource apps always comes with lot of bugs and problem i have never seen an open source app that works flawless. they just can get it right. Normally opening excel and pdf is fine but once they are being encrypted with a password it won't work or it will jump back to the beginning of the the sheet."
            2. _m pe_, 14.09.2026, 2/5: "won't properly paste from FUTO keyboard (pinned) & other text items, had to paste in note app them copy again. I appreciate you removed bugs recently but having to constantly make a copy of the document as everything is set to view only even though the file on LO Linux was editable is a recurring pain.No find and replace, couldn't search for case sensitive word.I do appreciate the dark mode though."
            3. _Jim_, 15.07.2026, 2/5: "The PDF format is not listed amongst the supported document types. Furthermore, the app has major problems when closing documents; it either takes an age to do so or freezes completely and crashes. And whilst using the app, pages – even though they have already loaded correctly and are still visible via their thumbnails – often become inaccessible after just a few seconds. Even scrolling manually does not display the individual page."
<!--/ir-theme-->
